Landed under the authorized inherited-failure exception for reviewed head `8541dfba8352394966bf64e5af12e4c1751b5446`.

[CI run 38461100147](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38461100147) completed all planned jobs. Its sole failed test job, `checks-node-changed-5`, has 16 failures in `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner.e2e.test.ts`; the aggregate CI gate is red for that job. Every other planned check passed or was intentionally skipped. All production/test typechecks, lint, security-fast, both planned UI E2E shards, and the repaired CLI test shard passed.

Exact main parent `7c1bf0c537ce4cd8cf2d84590640cd55676eeaaf` and that parent plus this change each reproduced 16 failures / 1 pass, exit 1, on the single failing file in the synthetic Team sandbox. All case names, error kinds, and admission stacks match current CI. The test clears runtime config, then unchanged placement admission reads it before the changed resolvers, which the test mocks. No CI rerun or branch refresh was used to chase green.

Native `scripts/pr merge-run` stopped before submission on a GitHub 502 while revalidating exact-attempt jobs and released its lock. The authorized squash API fallback was pinned to the exact reviewed head after checking current head, completed attempt, passing independent/security reviews, and absence of additional failed or pending checks. CI is not claimed green.
